Review the power rule and critical points (derivative = 0).
التكامل عكس الاشتقاق: <bdi dir="ltr">∫ xⁿ dx = xⁿ⁺¹ ÷ (n + 1) + C</bdi>. وللتكامل المحدد عوّض الحدين.
Integration reverses differentiation: ∫ xⁿ dx = xⁿ⁺¹ ÷ (n + 1) + C. For definite integrals, substitute both limits.
راجع العلاقة بين الدالتين: <bdi dir="ltr">ln(eᵏ) = k</bdi>، ومشتقة <bdi dir="ltr">e²ˣ = 2e²ˣ</bdi>.
Review ln and e: ln eᵏ = k, and the derivative of e²ˣ is 2e²ˣ.
للأحداث المستقلة نضرب الاحتمالين: <bdi dir="ltr">P(A</bdi>∩<bdi dir="ltr">B) = P(A) × P(B)</bdi>. وللتوافيق: <bdi dir="ltr">C(5, 2) = (5 × 4) ÷ (2 × 1)</bdi>.
For independent events multiply the probabilities: P(A∩B) = P(A) × P(B). For combinations: C(5, 2) = (5 × 4) ÷ (2 × 1).

q.ar: ⁦A⁩ و ⁦B⁩ حدثان مستقلان، ⁦P(A) = 0.4⁩ و ⁦P(B) = 0.5⁩. ما قيمة ⁦P(A ∩ B)⁩؟
s: للأحداث المستقلة: <bdi dir="ltr">P(A</bdi> ∩ <bdi dir="ltr">B) = P(A) × P(B)</bdi>
q.en: A and B are independent events with P(A) = 0.4 and P(B) = 0.5. What is P(A ∩ B)?
e: For independent events: P(A ∩ B) = P(A) × P(B)
